exercises.prompt: Complete the past negation with لَمْ: 'They did not write.'
exercises.explanation: لَمْ governs the imperfect in the jussive mood, dropping final nūn: يَكْتُبُوا.

feedback.rule: لَمْ + jussive (drops final nūn in al-afʿāl al-khamsah).

exercises.prompt: Which sentence expresses a prohibition ('Do not write!')?
exercises.explanation: Prohibitive لَا (lā al-nāhiyah) governs the 2nd-person imperfect in the jussive (sukūn): لَا تَكْتُبْ.

feedback.rule: لَا النَّاهِيَةُ + jussive = prohibition; لَا النَّافِيَةُ + indicative = statement.
